explanation: Rivers run downhill, not down the map: the Nile's sources lie in the highlands of East Africa. That is why Upper Egypt, upstream, is in the south.

claims.text: The Nile flows north through Egypt to the Mediterranean.
Through Egypt as a whole, the Nile does not flow south, east or west.
The Nile's sources lie in the highlands of East Africa, south of Egypt.
Upper Egypt, the upstream part of the Nile valley, lies in the south of the country.
